messages:
Priya: spotting: partner webhook delivered a payload that included what looks like an AWS access key (AKIA...) in plaintext. Found in staging logs bucket.
InfraBot: alert: SECRET_DETECTED in s3://staging-logs/webhook/2026-04-01/; pattern AKIA*****. Severity=high.
Ethan: thanks, Priya. Which lambda/service wrote it? Any indication this key was used from prod?
Priya: looks like the partner-ingest lambda (ingest-runner-staging) logged the payload at 2026-04-01T02:14:03Z. No CloudTrail activity from that key after that timestamp in our account.
Rosa: Ok treat as leaked creds. Plan: 1) ask partner to rotate immediately, 2) rotate in our Vault entry, 3) rewrap any Vault-wrapped blobs referencing that key, 4) tighten logs so payloads are redacted.
Platform: added RBAC mitigation: created a temporary IAM policy restricting partner-ingest role to only PutObject to their specific prefix and disabled long-lived credentials for new partner integrations. Will push short-lived STS option.
Oncall: I'll start rotation workflow. Priya, can you upload the exact object list to the ticket? Also need to snapshot Vault audit and our CloudTrail within the 2h window.
Priya: uploaded list (12 objects) and link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-8122. Also added a redacted log snippet.
Ethan: Quick KMS question: our Vault transit is backed by AWS KMS (customer master key) in us-east-1 for this cluster. Rewrap path: use vault operator rewrap or aws kms re-encrypt depending on whether the blobs are Vault-wrapped or raw KMS ciphertext.
Rosa: Most artifacts are raw S3 objects (not Vault wrapped) that were generated before we started wrapping. We'll run aws kms re-encrypt to change CMK and ensure no object references old key material.
Platform: small checklist:
- partner rotates key and confirms termination of old key
- update Vault secret: `vault kv put secret/partners/partnerX access_key=AKIA... secret_key=...`
- revoke old key in partner console
- run `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket staging-logs --prefix webhook/2026-04-01/` then re-encrypt each object with `aws kms re-encrypt` to new-key-id
- enable stricter logging redaction in lambda (filter sensitive fields)

Priya: partner rotated key at 03:03 UTC and confirmed revoke. I've pushed new creds to Vault at 03:12 UTC.
Oncall: rotating local copies and kicking off re-encrypt job. Doing a 5-object canary now.
Ethan: Can you also add a Vault audit entry retention extension? We should keep audit logs for 30 days for this incident.
Priya: extending Vault audit retention and exporting logs to the ticket storage.
Oncall: canary re-encrypt succeeded. Running bulk now. Estimated finish +45m.
Platform: rolled out RBAC short-lived STS to staging; creating rollout PR to prod with rate-limited canary.
Rosa: Created a small PR to sanitize lambda logging to redact keys and PII. Requesting review from devex.
Ethan: ran git-secrets scan across monorepo; found one historical accidental paste in an archived gist (no commits in main). Opening follow-up to ensure removal and notify partner.
Priya: re-encrypt finished at 04:10 UTC. Old partner key disabled. No suspicious usage found in CloudTrail for our account.
Oncall: closing thread and attaching artifacts to SEC-8122. Postmortem owners: Rosa (write), Priya (forensics), Platform (RBAC follow-through).
InfraBot: incident update: severity=low-after-mitigation, ticket=SEC-8122, artifacts=true, responders=[Priya,Ethan,Rosa,Platform,Oncall]
